# `deprecated-added`

Marked deprecated

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `deprecated-added` |
| **Status** | Planned (M6) |
| **Group** | Lifecycle and versions ([RULES.md section 9](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An operation, parameter, property or schema was marked `deprecated`.

## Why this default

Nothing breaks yet; it starts the deprecation period.

## Example

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  deprecated-added: info
```
